description: Adds a category (a filter tab) to a showcase. Use it to group items, e.g. one category per project type or source folder, before tagging them; upload and tagging tools also create missing categories by name. If one with the same name or slug exists, it's returned instead of creating a duplicate.

slug.description: URL form, e.g. "kitchen-remodels"; derived from the name if omitted.

name: create_category
title: Create category
